title: SpanIngestRequest
description: Frozen Day 1 contract: what the Python SDK POSTs to the backend on POST /v1/spans. trace_id is null when the SDK is starting a new trace; the server creates the trace and returns its id. Costs are server-computed, never trusted from the client.

trace_id.description: Existing trace to append to, or null to auto-create a trace from this span.

parent_span_id.description: Parent span, or null for the root span of the trace.

capture_prompt.description: Privacy switch. When false, prompt_text/response_text must be omitted.

metadata.description: Genuinely optional extras only. Anything queried routinely belongs in a real column.
